stories.heading: Start with one clear offer
stories.body: Before adding more copy, check whether the headline and the next action say the same thing. A focused message is easier to review.

stories.heading: Make follow-up part of the workflow
stories.body: Review enquiries alongside their latest activity. Assign one owner and one next action so the handoff is clear.

stories.heading: A small check before you approve
stories.body: Confirm the destination, contact details and approved budget before publishing. Preparation is not approval.
